newsitem.title: NORWAY: Oslo shares dip as Norsk Hydro bows to pressure.
newsitem.headline: Oslo shares dip as Norsk Hydro bows to pressure.

text.p: Norwegian shares closed moderately lower on Friday as industry heavyweight Norsk Hydro came under pressure from profit taking, dealers said. Trade was calm as investors awaited fresh U.S. data.
"It was remarkably quiet today," said one dealer. "Investors have been waiting for new figures from the United States for almost the entire session."
The Total share index closed 0.5 percent down at 822.6 points in turnover worth 512 million crowns.
Norsk Hydro, by far the biggest company listed on the stock exchange, dropped six crowns to 294 crowns.
Some dealers, seeing no fundamental reason behind the downward move, attributed the fall to profit taking after recent gains.
"But I think Hydro will bounce back soon, especially as oil prices seem to be holding at firm levels," said another dealer.
The shipping sector was the session's best performer with the shipping index rising 0.34 percent to 762.48 points.
"The shipping sector seems quite good at the moment. Some drilling companies have earned good rates lately, I guess we can expect further gains with the dollar being quite strong."
